caption: The drawing depicts a large, realistically rendered blue tin box with rounded edges, placed against a plain beige background. The box features a detailed illustration on its sides, showing a lively outdoor garden scene with several trees, people standing and walking, a fence, and a central building labeled "CASTLE GARDEN." The scene includes flags flying on poles, and the people are dressed in period clothing. The top of the box is decorated with what appears to be floral or abstract patterns in muted tones of blue, pink, and gray. The lid has a rim with vertical decorative segments that alternate in color. The blue hue dominates the composition, with accents of green, brown, white, and other earth tones used for the people, trees, and building details. The perspective and shading suggest a three-dimensional form to the tin box.
title: Bandbox with Cover
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
